_comment: digperiphs (EVFAB) proof configuration: the Castalia defaults with the EVFAB0 event/trigger fabric instantiated in the MUTEX page (page 2) sub-slot 11 (peripherals.eventFabric=true, @0x6B00) AND every one of its producer/consumer blocks present, so the FULL crossbar wiring is elaborated and booted -- rtc (EV0/EV1), pwm (EV2/EV3 + task T4), nfc (EV8/EV9), dma with 4 channels (EV10/EV11/EV12 + tasks T0/T1 + the ch_busy OVR taps), trng (EV13) and i2ctarget (EV14) join the always-present TIMER0 (EV4/EV5 + tasks T2/T3), TIMER1 (EV6), UART0 (EV7), GPIO0 (the masked-edge EV15 path + tasks T7/T8), PWRCTRL (task T5) and NPU0 (task T6 + the NpuActive busy tap). EVFAB0 is a page-2 native slave with the usual PLAIN raw-strobe active-low shim (D4: no CAPTURE_CLOCK pre-latch, no en_q) whose whole crossbar rides the FREE-RUNNING mclk in the always-on domain -- PWRCTRL never gates it, so chains keep firing with every hart in WFI. It is VECTORLESS (design-doc D20): irq_evfab is a constant '0' inside the block and is left open at the MCU level, so this knob adds NOTHING to the A5 library-tail vector table -- the IRQ source list stays exactly where the other enabled blocks put it (here 124, from i2ctarget's vectors 122/123). Zero pins. Because dma is on, this configuration also carries the arbiter fabric widening N=4->5 / MW=3 that the DMA knob owns. The MIRROR-IMAGE proof is the DEFAULT build: with eventFabric false the emitted MCU.vhd is BYTE-IDENTICAL (no sub-slot 11 decode, no EVF* register block, no tap port-map lines), and with the fabric on but a producer block off that producer's ev_in bit and task connections tie '0' (design-doc D23) rather than being left open. Prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_evfab.json
